buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): AS PER MSF SCOPE OF WORK Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: AS PER MSF SCOPE OF WORK 5. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Against the Experience Criteria, the Bidder should have executed the same or similar type of servic e /job work i.e. the firm should have credential of supplying hot rolled material of round dia/RCS/square mi n. Dia 30 mm or firm should have plant and machinery facility for carrying out hot rolling operation of min. Dia 30 mm to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company during last 03 Financial years from the date of opening of technical bid. The firm must attach scanned copy of Tax Invoices / Suppl

y orders or documentary evidence in support of proof regarding plant and machinery facility for carrying o ut hot rolling operation of min. dia 30 mm for evaluation of its offer along with technical bid. The experienc e criteria GeM GTC will be superseded by this clause. 2. Against the Past Performance Criteria, the Bidder should have supplied same or similar category pr oduct i.e. the firm should have credential of supplying hot rolled material of round dia/RCS/square min. Dia 30 mm or firm should have plant and machinery facility for carrying out hot rolling operation of min. Dia 30 mm for 20% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant Tax Invoice s / CRAC/Performance Certificate proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year or d ocumentary evidence in support of proof regarding plant and machinery facility for carrying out hot rolling operation of min. dia 30 mm to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year. The Past Performance criteria of GeM GTC will be superseded by this clause. 3. Against Plant and Machinery facility for carrying out hot rolling operation of min. dia 30 mm claimed by the firm , MSF may carry out Capacity Verification of the firm to ascertain the hot rolling capacity claime d by the firm. 4. Bidder shall carefully read the clauses mentioned in ATC & shall attach the compliance of the sa me duly signed and stamped. 5. EMD shall be exempted for the MSE firms having valid UDYAM registration and also who are registe red with the Central Purchase Organization or the concerned Ministry or Department (including OFs) or Sta rtups as recognized by Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP), irrespective of the store for w hich they are registered. The bidders have to submit documentary evidence (with validity) in support of th eir claim for EMD exemption. 6. Against the MSE policy “if the bidder wants to avail the purchase preference, the bidder must be a service provider of the offered service/job”. In this regard bidder has to submit the declaration against ser vice provider of the offered service/ jobs in firm’s letter head duly signed and stamped along with MSE (UD YYAM). 7. Mandate Form to be submitted in prescribed format. 8. Local Content Form to be submitted in prescribed format. 9. MSE & Start-up firm’s should not be relaxed from experience criteria. Exemption will be applicable turnover only. 10. Performance Security Deposit @ 5 % of the Purchase Order value (including Taxes & Duties) is r equired to be submitted by the successful Bidder in the form of a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) or F ixed Deposit Receipt from a Scheduled Commercial Bank notified by Reserve Bank of India, in the prescrib ed format within thirty days from receipt date of S.O. in favour of METAL AND STEEL FACTORY ISHAPORE, A UNIT OF YANTRA INDIA LIMITED. PSD should remain valid for a period of sixty days beyond the date of c ompletion of contractual obligations, including warranty. In case the execution of the contract is delayed beyond the contracted period and the purchaser grants extension of delivery period, with or without LD, th e supplier must get the PSD revalidated, if not already valid. (Performance Security Deposit is, however, n ot necessary for contracts valuing up to Rs. 10 lakh. Above Rs. 10 lakh, PSD is mandatory). 11. OPTION CLAUSE: The Buyer reserves the right to place orders for additional quantity up to a maxi mum of 25% of the originally contracted quantity at the same rate and terms of contract within the original Delivery Period (DP) as well as Refixed/ Extended DP. [Please note that if option clause is operated then Fir m have to submit PSD @ 5% of additional supply order value, if PSD is applicable]. 12. Delivery terms: FOR, MSF 13. Payment Terms: MSF Standard payment terms is 100% payment against contractor’s bill by Ac count transfer through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted materials within 30 (Thirty) days from the date of rece ipt of materials at MSF or submission of bills/documents & PSD (if applicable), whichever is later and as per Scope of Work. 14. Delivery Period: Within 120 days from the date of placement of S.O. and as per MSF Scope of Wor k.

15. Against Bank Guarantee the firm must submit the same after verification of the BGs through SFMS service of the issuing Bank. The Bank Guarantee will be considered as valid only after verification of SFMS service otherwise same will treated as invalid. 16. The firm shall execute the service/job work strictly as per MSF Scope of Work & MSF item specifica tion. 17. The Service is required for rolling of forged 95(+5) mm RCS steel billets to different dia . The esti mated quantities for rolling are ; (a) 60 mm dia – 264 Kg, (b) 30 mm dia – 187 Kg, (c) 50 mm dia – 389 Kg, (d) Torsion Bar 50 mm dia – 688 Kg, (e) 75 mm dia – 500 Kg, (f) 46 mm dia – 13280 Kg, (g) 34 mm dia – 15 652 Kg, (h) 36 mm dia – 20313 Kg and (i) 45 mm dia – 10000 Kg). The bidder shall be quote an all inclusiv e single rate for the complete scope of work, based on which the total price shall be evaluated. 18. MSD: - MSD shall applicable as per MSF Scope of Work Point No.5. 19. All other Terms & conditions will be strictly governed by YILSPM 2024 and as per MSF Scope of Wo rk. 20. Firm should read the ATC (additional Terms & Conditions) of this TE carefully and submit the desir e documents along with Technical bid. 21. Arbitration Clause : As per Yantra India Ltd. Store Procurement Manual 2024. 22. Bidders shall comply all the TE terms & Conditions unequivocally. 23.
